correctness.rationale: Root-time decomposition on independent cavity branches gives the exact full probability-generating polynomial. The cavity ODE solves explicitly on degree-Δ regular trees, with a rigorously finite causal influence cone. Coefficient extraction and a transformed one-dimensional joint-moment integral verify all normalizations and quantifiers. Symbolic algebra verifies strict covariance/cumulant expressions and the positive lower bound for the cumulant bracket; finite-tree Monte Carlo corroborates degrees 3 and 4 without serving as proof. A high-degree exponential expansion gives the logarithmic enhancement; no physical relaxation-time claim is made.

value.rationale: In blocking RSA, the full local coordination distribution is a natural physical observable that refines known one-point density and pair correlations. Opposite signed pair and triplet connected correlations give a structural warning against factorization or naive sign extrapolation. Even when local occupancy is rare, the probability of a completely empty neighbor shell is amplified by an unbounded logarithmic factor compared with a same-marginal independent model. This matters directly for jammed local-void morphology, is not a mere parameter substitution, and supplies an exact all-degree benchmark.
